rowOrder: one row per registration from row 2, ordered by registration time, oldest first; with no registration only the header row exists (AC-008-03)
cellRules: Every cell is a string cell, so a value starting with =, +, - or @ is never evaluated as a formula (SB-05).
Text is written as stored (UTF-8 in, Unicode cells out), so č, š, ž survive (NFR-01).
An empty cell means the field does not belong to the registration type.
Only the columns below; no internal or system data (SR-07).

columns.value: '{consentId} ({givenAt})' for each consent given, joined with '; '
